title: Figure 1: Simplified Setup and Probability Distributions
html: Figure 1. Simplified setup. (a) An electron beam passes through a wall with two slits. A movable mask is positioned to block the electrons, only allowing those traversing through slit 1 (P_1), slit 2 (P_2), or both (P_{12}) to reach the backstop and detector. (b, c) Probability distributions are shown (experimental in false-colour intensity) for electrons that pass through a single slit (b), or the double-slit (c). Inset 1, 2: Electron micrographs of the double-slit and mask. The individual slits are 50 nm wide \times 4 \mum tall with a 150 nm support structure midway along their height, and separated by 280 nm. The mask is 5 \mum wide \times 20 \mum tall.
